nom: Naturium Barrier Bounce Advanced Skin Hydrator

avis.texte: This is one of my favorites. A little goes a long way and feels amazing.
This product is very emollient and hydrating but I dont like how heavy and oily it is. It just sits on my skin doesn't seem to absorb. Would not buy again .

This is a very emollient, greasy serum. It will not be for everyone. But I really like it as an overnight mask a couple of times a week and more often in the winter. It does not absorb great so it gets on my pillow, but I find that it does an excellent job keeping dry patches at bay.

This has become my favorite moisturizer, hands down! I'm 40 years old and have always use high-end products, but this last year (age 39), I noticed my skin just needed more moisture and glow, and something to make my face look more youthful. I used Clinique's Moisture Surge (it was OK, nothing "wow" about it for what I was looking for), and D'Alba's First Spray for glow (I don't really notice a difference?). They weren't anything compared this moisturizer. My husband uses it now, too (he's 48). He's never stolen any skin care of mine except this lol I hope this product stays forever. Sometimes you have to shake it really well so the consistency stays the same, but, alright? Makeup goes on beautifully afterwards, too and I always get compliments on my skin.

I love how my skin looks after using it. Makes it look very hydrated and give it a beautiful natural look. I would use it by itself before workouts and like not feeling greasy at all after sweating. I like that it doesn't have a weird smell even with a fragrance

Leaves my skin feeling great! I've used a lot of products over the years and I'm very impressed with how soft my face feels. I also have rosacea and a gluten allergy and have had no reactions to the products.
Really liked this product but it separated after only 3 months. Will not repurchase. Also, ultra would not refund

I have very dry, sensitive eczema and acne prone skin. It's very reactive so it can be hard to find products that don't trigger one or the other. This has been great for my texture and healing my skin barrier without causing acne breakouts. The texture is interesting - it's very runny at first but then as you blend it in it kind of sets down and takes a little more work to really rub in. But with very dry skin, I appreciate how occlusive it feels because it feels like it seals all the moisture into my skin. I also think even if you don't have dry skin like me, this is a great option for a moisturizer because it's not thick at all. I'm still undecided on if I'd repurchase but I think the product itself is amazing.

After a single use, this oil based serum completely broke me out. I haven't gotten this many large pimples from a product in years. The serum itself is milky and appears lightweight. However, it does not sink into the skin and leaves a very greasy layer for hours. Very disappointed in the product, I would return it immediately if I could
I just received my first bottle of this amazing serum. I've used it for 2 days and I am completely in love with it. Seriously!!!

The product comes out separated, even after shaking very well. I've just been rubbing it together in my hands to combine it before applying, but disappointing to have a serum come out of the bottle like that.

avis.titre: My #1 skincare product in my whole routine
avis.texte: I ran out of my first bottle after 8mo and my skin was absolutely begging me to buy it again. I first tried this serum after I told an Ulta employee that everything (makeup, serums, moisturizers, spf, etc) kept pilling off my face. My skin was SO dry. I'm so glad she recommended this product bcuz I'm in love with it, it saved my skin, and I'll buy it forever. Without it, my skin is so tight, a little flaky, and it's as if I applied no moisturizers at all. So if you have extra dry skin, this will change your life.

I have pretty dry skin. Everything I was using just kept pilling on my face, both skincare and makeup. An Ulta employee suggested this for me and it's now my holy grail. I use it every single day. Not only does my skin not feel tight and dry anymore but it's the only thing that keeps products smoothly on my face! I love this stuff

if you have dry skin, suffering from indoor winter skin, anything.... this will save it. I used multiple moisturizers wondering why I was so dry still and decided to try this and now I am obsessed! use it in the evening... yes it is greasy, but if that is the price to pay to wake up glowy and plump and not dry, so be it. Only gripe is the size for the price.
One of my favorite Naturium skin care products! Shake it up and pump 3x and your face will be super soft & glowy. One star off as i wish the bottle was bigger for the $$. This is my 4th bottle.

My skin was in full rebellion with winter dry air and inside heating. I tried this product on a whim and within two days my skin was supple and mositurized. I'd even go as far as saying it gave me the coveted glass skin. Sure the texture is a little strange and sure it seeks kinda greasy but when your skin barrier is suffering, this is necessary! Put a light coat on after evening cleanse, wake up with refreshed skin. This product rivals some of those high end/big label things that make promises they don't deliver. This one delivers.

I have very dry skin and picked this up thinking it would he nourishing and hydrating. This product had the worst texture I've ever put on my face. It is slick, greasy, and does not absorb into the skin. After one use I saw small bumps appearing on my skin that went away with a few washes. Over all the opposite of what I was looking for.

I absolutely love this product. I wish I had found it sooner. My mom's dermatologist recommended it to her because she has dry skin and I ended up trying it because I also have dry skin and it has forever changed my life. I can't go without it. It is so hydrating!!

This is so moisturizing and nourishing. I only wish I found it sooner so I could have used it all winter. I have combination sensitive skin, breakout prone. I think its important to note that what people think is a "greasy" or "oily" feeling is actually the urea acting as a powerful humectant, pulling moisture from the air to put into the skin. It tends to have a sticky residue, that means it's working. However, it absorbs well and I have no problem putting a full face of makeup ontop. My skin is noticeably smoother and has mitigated the redness and irritation from the below zero temps. This has become a new staple in my routine. I can't believe its less than $20. This isnt a sponsored review, I really love this sh*t.
I had a messed up skin barrier and this fixed it right away!!! Would only recommend for dry skin or if skin barrier needs to fixed. Very soothing and moisturizing

avis.titre: Once you try it you'll love it!
avis.texte: I absolutely love this serum, it's very much like the Tatcha plumping Serum, but at a fraction of the price. This serum will be in my rotation part of my skin care.

avis.titre: Dry and mature skin's best friend
avis.texte: This product does exactly what it says it does. It is hydrating and plumps and nourishes the skin while leaving a youthful looking glow. It lays well beneath makeup and is a Holy Grail product for me. But, i don't believe it is for everyone. I give it 5 stars for my dry, mature skin type. Like some of the negative reviews note, it might be too much for those with oily skin. Also, if you don't have a consistent skin regime, this product may not absorb well due to exfoliation needs. Products can only work as well as you work with them and they won't work for every skin type. This formulation is pretty specific for those leaning dry, in my opinion.

I wanted to add a barrier serum to my skincare routine for the winter. I found the product to be horribly greasy and never seeming to fully absorb. I was constantly blotting at my face and I could feel it sitting really heavy on the surface. I've tried using it on my body, but the greasy feeling persists. This might work for people with dry skin, but it's a no for me. The packaging has a good weight to it, but that makes it really hard to tell how much of it you have left. I didn't break out, but I couldn't get a good read on the product because I had to keep wiping it off.
My personal opinion is that I do not like the "greasy" feeling of this product.
I've been using this product for 3 months. When I use this, my skin feels fresh and looks glowy which I love this look. Just a little bit of this is enough for the entire face.

I bought this product because I have been experiencing some dryness on my chin. Like some people mentioned there is a water consistency on the first pump but it can be fix by shaking the bottle before. I would not recommend it. At some point it stings the area i wanted to improved. Also I want fan of the oil finish.

This stuff is amazing. I have been struggling with menopausal skin, and after the first night I am hooked. I am dry, sensitive to fragrance, and prone to breakouts. Nothing worked like this, it feels luxurious going on, and shows the magic in the morning. Soft, smooth, hydrated skin!
Application isn't my favorite and u gotta shake that mug deeown but it gives such a gorgeous glow!

Maine winters + dry/ combo skin = a compromised barrier. This is the only product that keeps my skin hydrated properly November- March. If you don't like to look or feel like a glistening goddess this product isn't for you because you WILL be dewy all day. Just make sure you vigorously shake the bottle every time you use it.

I am in my late 30s, I have dry skin during the colder months, and weak skin barrier. I have occasional break outs, and the breakouts disappear the following day after I use this serum. I do not understand how I wake up glowy, face looks so clear, and barrier feels extra strong. The consistency is serum-oily texture. As soon as it touches my face, it feels like a hug on my skin. I am almost done with my first bottle and this is my winter holy grail! My barrier depends on this every single night. The smell is sweet and disappears after rubbing the serum in. Naturium really worked their magic with this amazing formula.
It makes your face feel very soft and actually does feel like it provides a barrier on your skin

avis.titre: One of my all time faves
avis.texte: I absolutely love this cream. It's so rich and hydrating, perfect for dry skin girlies. Might be too much for oily skin. I have been putting with tretinoin at night, and under makeup in the am. Leaves skin glowy with no makeup pilling. Right up there with my super satty from experiment for all-time favorite serum/barrier product. Seriously it's so good. Going to buy some for my mom at Christmas.
This has a lovely tecture with a dewy finish. I love it for the winter, or irritated skin.

barrier bounce is my R.O.D truly! It gives me GLASS skin and CURED my perioral dermatitis that I unfortunately got from using tretinoin! This over my clindamycin lotion did WONDERS for my perioral dermatitis. will use this forever!
Love this serum, feels very silky and helps keep my skin calm and hydrated. I use it morning and night and just bought my second one.
Love love love it. Just like everything else from Naturium. I all of my skincare and my entire shower routine is from Naturium.

avis.titre: I like it, however a bit on the oily side.
avis.texte: I produce a lot of oils in the face, so I feel like this product is not the best for me. However, I like the texture when applying. So far my skin looks good. This is more for a dry skin person.
This a must for anyone living in a dry environment like Colorado. I need a JUMBO size of this immediately. This along with marshmallow balm has made such a difference in my hydration game.

I love love love barrier bounce! I have very dry skin and this serum feels amazing on my skin. This is an oil-based serum so if you have oily or acne-prone skin this probably isn't for you but if you have normal or dry skin then definitely try this!!
The consistency is a little sticky but does give a nice glow so I do still like it

avis.titre: Not great for combo/oily skin type
avis.texte: I bought this a few months ago and have found it to not suit my combo/oily skin type. The product just seems to sit on top of my skin rather than absorb, as well as make me feel sweaty and sticky. I think it has also caused some clogging due to this. If you have drier skin and are looking to be glowy, this is a wonderful product, however for my oily gals it may not be your fav.
I love this product, it gives my mature skin a wonderful glow! Would definitely recommend!!
I bought it out of curiosity, but i ended up loving it and now i have 1 of my daughters using it too. Tje moisturizing in this product and the glow is inexplicable. Highly recommend 👌 👍 👏 🙌

This is my favorite product. If I was only allowed one skincare product, this would be it! My only complaint is that I go through it to fast - please make a jumbo. I put this on at night, after any other skincare or alone, and I'm not shy about it. My skin looks so good in the morning - a slash of water and I'm ready to go. If I want to wear makeup, I love this as my first step. I feel bouncy and dewy and my makeup looks great. If you don't want to look glowing and dewy then you may not love this under makeup. If Naturium wants to amp up the urea and make a jumbo, that'd be amazing! Age 51/fair/blonde/FL

This serum seems like it's going to be fine when I first pump it out of the bottle, but applying it isn't the greatest experience. It's very "grippy" and difficult to spread evenly over the face. It also has a greasy look and feel, and my skin is not oily. I can't bring myself to test it long enough to determine if it actually does anything for my skin. I managed two or three uses and now it's just collecting dust in my bathroom.

avis.titre: Great product, but problem with assembly I believe
avis.texte: I bought this product a few months back. I used it twice & fell in love with it. Unfortunately, when i went to use it a 3rd time, nothing came out. I thought it was clogged, but after opening the lid I seen that the bottle was empty. I was so sad. I have no idea how that happened. The package was intact when I received it. It somehow must have been an assembly line problem. My life has been so busy that I never contacted manufacturer. I would've definitely gave it a 5 star review had I received the product filled. It was probably a fluke. I will be opening the next bottle to make sure I get what I paid for!

avis.titre: There is a reason she is queen and viral
avis.texte: My favorite product. Truly. I have very dry skin and I use this at night before bed and have the most hydrated bouncy skin. It feels so luxury yet so affordable. I have gotten a lot of my friends and family into using this.

First and foremost, thank you, NATURIUN! You have been nothing but a blessing to my skincare journey. I've been struggling for years, spending money on various products and seeking advice from my doctor. Nothing seemed to work. A family friend recommended NATURIUN to me, and I decided to give it a try. (Alhamdulillah!) (Thanks be to God!) I'm so happy with the NATURIUN products I'm using. I have nothing negative to say about any of them. I'll add pictures before and after using their products. Please please NATURIUUB DO NOT CHANGE ANYTHING ABOUT THIS PRODUCTS.

So incredibly unique for the market! 5% urea triggers my rosacea but makes my skin so hydrated. 2% is the perfect balance it seems. Smell is a bit funky and having to shake it's a bit concerning from the reviews that it separates, but seriously magical and I hope you never stop producing this!

seems like a really nice product but it caused my skin to breakout. attempted 3 different times and my skin did not agree with this product, although there are other serums from Naturium that I really enjoy.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: I absolutely love this product and made such a difference in my skin. I am 67 and get do many compliments on my skin
Love the barrier bounce it's amazing my skin looks so good since I started using this product
I get excited to use this product on my face. I actually look forward to this step in my facial routine
This is a pretty thick product so I don't feel like it spreads well, but it works really well.
This is probably my favorite part of my skin care routine. I apply it before my moisturizer every morning and it works wonders. I am 55 and this is a game changer for dry skin!
I've layered moisturizers and serums and locked in with Vaseline and nothing kept my moisture like this serum! Love it!! I have
I found this to be quite sticky feeling even after drying down and the smell was off putting, like the oils are rancid. I am wondering if I received a bad batch. Really wanted this to work for me.

First of all, you must SHAKE this product (a lot) when you first get it. At first it came out as oil but after you shake it properly, it's a white liquid. Anyways, 2 pumps for my face and 1 pump for my neck is perfection. I use this at night after my adapolene and before my moisturizer. If you want extra plumpness and do not mind an oily, glowy feel, you'd love this. If you have oily skin, you might not like this. But I love this on my combo, mature skin!

I was worried about the consistency after reading some of the reviews but it's actually really nice. I did shake well, not much more than I do any other product, and it came out perfect. It's much thicker than I thought it would be but it's very nice on the skin. The fruity, berry smell isn't my favorite but I understand the need to cover chemical smells sometimes so I'm not complaining given how well it's worked on my skin. I absolutely LOVE Naturium products. They haven't let me down yet!
My skin is so soft and glowy! I absolutely love this serum! 💜

I was very happy with the consistency of the product. It adds hydration and a beautiful 'glass like' glow. Unfortunately, I noticed after a couple uses, my skin was reacting with a few pink small bumps that gave away I was allergic to something in it. If this works for you, i think you wokld like it

My skin LOVES this product. It is thick so use it as nighttime. I can see this working for both dry and oily. A little does go a long way. My skin feels smoother, more plump, and even in tone. I will forever and ever repurchase this product
Love this. I use this as a step before my moisturizer and it creates a nice glow.

All in all I really like this product. I highly recommend shaking it a bunch when you buy it because I thought it was supposed to be an almost watery texture but nope! it's a bit on the sticky side at first but I find this to work best when my face is damp from a toner/mist. once absorbed my skin does seem to stay hydrated and plump feeling throughout the day!

avis.titre: It has replaced some of my serums
avis.texte: I really like this. It's a bit oily but I was looking for something that would replace some of my serums and this worked fine for me. I will use for about 90 days just to see if it holds up but for now, I like it.

I use tretinoin and it was making my usually oily skin super dry, so I got this product and use 3 pumps at night on top my the tretinoin and like half a pump during the day mixed with my vitamin c serum. It works phenomenally and totally cured the dry patches the retinol was causing. It feels a little greasy but it absorbs nicely and from someone with oily skin type, using just a little in the morning doesn't make me look overly greasy, just "glowy" enough (I do use a matte sunscreen and matte primer regularly though). Definitely worth a try for retinol users!

I use this as my everyday moisturizer. Ever using tretinoin I have severe dry skin and nothing seems to keep me moisturized. Not only does this keep my skin hydrated but it helps to stop the pealing I get from tret. 20/10 I'll always buy this
This is an amazing product. Makes my skin just glow. Gave my 60 year old skin back its bounce!

I was so hesitant to buy this. I normally don't like oily textures. Now I wish I had this from release day. I use it daily and can't get enough. It makes your skin so soft and hydrated AND moisturized. And the glow!!!! Wow. I will never be without this in my routine again. Ever.

Bought this a couple days ago and used as directed. Immediately broke out in red, itchy bumps that haven't gone away. Product is greasy and doesn't look at all like what's pictured here. My skin is not sensitive and hasn't broken out in YEARS. Not sure what happened with this product but I'm so frustrated and worried about my skin now

shame on me for not thoroughly reading the ingredients of this product. I was interested to try this because I love hydrating products, especially skin barrier improving products. I am quite sensitive to a chemical exfoliants, particularly if they are in a serum that is left on my skin. Long story short, this product has lactic acid in it. Correct me if I'm wrong, but exfoliants of any kind can damage your skin barrier if it is compromised. I would never use a moisturizing serum with a chemical exfoliant when my skin is dehydrated, and I need to focus on hydrating and soothing it. not for me! would not recommend if you have sensitive skin, dehydrated, skin, etc.
This product was weird it was tacky after application and just made me feel sticky and greasy. Its super thick and just didnt even hydrate my skin it wouldnt penetrate
The Barrier Bounce formula is perfection especially when trying to obtain the glass skin look. I use it as my last step in my skin care regimen and it is pure magic!

I really loved the ingredients in this product but it has a sticky consistency that I could not get past. It was hard to spread on my face and although it looks good under makeup, it was difficult to apply it due to the stickiness feel. Really wanted to love it but had to return.
The Best Naturium product is barrier bounce. It's versatile and sits beautifully under makeup! It just makes your skin have a healthy glow!!
Great Product. I will definitely be purchasing again and again. It really soaks into my skin and makes i feel nourished and smooth.
I love the radiance that llaves in my skin. I can use it without make up or with.
I love this stuff! I have such dry skin, I use it morning and night. I can't live without it- the hydration the dewy glow is the best!

I've repurchased this multiple times, i use this at night so it can eliminate my acne and it works effectively! ive noticed a huge change especially since i struggle with hormonal acne, i give this a 10/10!

I've repurchased this multiple times, i use this at night so it can eliminate my acne and it works effectively! ive noticed a huge change especially since i struggle with hormonal acne, i give this a 10/10!

"This product is one of a kind, and it's so versatile! I can layer it on under makeup to add a dewy glow or use it as part of a night time skincare slug so my skin stays hydrated throughout the night. It can do it all!"
This would have 5 stars if it didn't smell like flowery crayons. It's so great for my dry sensitive skin, but the scent really throws me off.

This product quickly from the first use became a must have in my daily routine, leaves my skin feeling so soft and moisturized and wears perfectly under primer and foundation. Have already repurchased 5 times along with several other products from this line.

So far im loving this. I have extremely sensitive skin that just reacts to literally everything. I have dehydrated almost like stressed skin. Even though i have a skin care routine. It wasnt working. I switched to this and i think im gana stick with it!!! I honestly love it
I love how this makes my skin feel. It's the best part of myskin care routine.

This is my absolute new favorite addition to my skin care routine. It feels so good on my skin. It's luxurious to apply, and I love how my skin glows. This truly is a game changer for my dry, Colorado skin.
Consistency is not what is shows. Runny and separated. I I feel duped.

avis.titre: Surprised by how much I love this
avis.texte: Bought this on a whim to try and im so glad i did! It feels amazing putting it on - really thick and nourishing. My dry/dehydrated skin plumps up and looks amazing after using this. I think maybe ots the oil content but i will keep coming back to this as long as they carry it.

It's a liquidy lotion. I got a good bottle. No trouble with separation of ingredients if shaken. I have used many moisturizers in my 70+ years but this feels the most soothing for my dry, retinoid treated skin.The ingredients are fabulous and you only need a teaspoon.of product for the entire face to feel the effect. I use it morning and night and it plays well with makeup.
Unfortunately, this product made my face red and had a lot of burning/itching. I really wish this product worked for me because it made my skin very dewy and very hydrated.

avis.titre: Fixed my post radiation, post chemo skin!
avis.texte: My skin was wrecked after undergoing radiation and being on targeted chemo meds. Very flaky, pale and colorless. It became very obvious when I went searching for a new, lightweight SPF foundation. Everything looked awful and would just sit in the top of my skin and accentuate the dry patches and wrinkles. I worked on exfoliating and then started using the Barrier Bounce , the peptide serum, peptides eye cream and peptide moisturizer. Literally within days, people were complimenting me on my skin, including my oncologist and her nurse, saying; "Your skin looks great, you got your color back!". Thank you Naturium...
I decided to try this and wish I had sooner! Great moisture and gives a really nice dewy glow. I'm 53 and feel like this has been key to improved hydration and better texture.

This product feels thick and luxurious for a serum. Can be used as a moisturizer as it is an oil based serum. But honestly I didn't see any difference. It may have even broken me out a bit. Not for me.

avis.titre: Where have you been all my life?
avis.texte: This face cream is lite weight yet has the perfect amount of moisture without being greasy. It also gives a dewy glass skin glow. It does not pill under sunscreen or makeup. Please make a jumbo size.

avis.titre: Amazing Must Have Addition to My Routine
avis.texte: The most amazing formulation that leaves your skin dewy and soft. Never greasy!

avis.titre: Moisturizing but hard to rub in
avis.texte: Really love this product for the moisture. After overdoing it with retinol, I had super dry skin and this brought it back to life! My only complaint is that it does not rub in very easily. It needs a bit more slip but overall love the results!

Living in CO has my skin DRY year round (IYKYK). This product literally completely saved it AND fixed my perioral dermatitis! 😍😭 Its VERY glowy at first & the tiniest bit sticky but it sinks in pretty quickly leaving you looking fresh & radiant. I put this on in place of moisturizer (day & night) & cannot believe how divine my skin looks & feels! Will continue to repurchase & recommend!
I have oily combo skin. Even in LA my skin gets dry in the winter. this stuff is amazing. Preps rje skin really well for those heavy duty matte looks.
Took a few times to see results from this, but I love. Pairs great with my active serums for night time

My skin has looked and felt so healthy since using this oil-serum. I am very skincare savvy and this is made for all skin types. But if you "prefer" to have a matte skin look then i wouldnt suggest onviously

I absolutely adore Naturium and use several of their products. I was recently in the market for a new serum, one without a dropper applicator (why do they keep making those?), so I landed on Barrier Bounce. While I do think this is a nice serum, I find the consistency to be a little off. It is a bit thicker than what you might expect, and seems difficult to rub in. Yes, I shake the bottle and even hit the bottom of it to make sure it is all mixed up, but I don't think I like it more than my previous serum. It does provide nice hydration though, so if you need a boost during winter months this would definitely work. I am on the fence about repurchasing.

avis.titre: The only thing saving my skin right now....
avis.texte: I am at that age (44) where my skin is definitely going through changes. I went from super oily to extremely dry overnight. I am so impressed with this serum and will continue to buy for my overly parched skin. I use about three pumps and it makes my skin so glowy and hydrated immediately getting rid of any itcheness or discomfort. It works well under make-up, alone, or sometimes I even top it with a face oil for days when it's super cold and dry out. This probably would be too much for anyone with oily skin, but if you are on the fence, I highly recommend.
This product is for the dry skin girlies ONLY. You have to shake before you use it. It leaves my skin so glowy and hydrating. Suprisingly a good makeup primer as well!
Keeps my face looking so nice and moisturized.will definitely buy again
Oh my goodness! I have dehydrated skin and it always feels tight deep down, no matter how much cream I put on but this serum changed all that. My skin finally feels hydrated!!!!

I bought this for my boyfriend because he was having bad eczema irritation with skin flaking and dryness from a change in weather. He tries not to rely too much on his steroid cream unless absolutely necessary. This product did the trick of helping soothe his facial and now it's in his regular routine for the winter. You DO have the SHAKE the bottle a ton at first to get the right consistency. when my skin feels dehydrated I put this on as my last layer, wait a few min and then put my SPF on if it's daytime. I have normal non sensitive skin and this is what works for me.
It's still the great formula but i noticed it's got a purple hue to it now. This is my 3rd bottle ❤️
My dry skin drinks this up, and I'm left with soft hydrated skin. Doesn't break me out. No oily residue and works well under makeup.
This feels so nice on my skin. Right after I wash, I use this on top of my toner. My skin feels plump, bouncy, and beautiful. I am OBSESSED! Please don't ever discontinue this product.

When Barrier Bounce first dropped I wasn't entirely sure about the impact of the product therefore doubted the product entirely. However, I was struggling with dry skin and found out it was because my skin barrier was compromised (I have combo oily dry skin). That being said, while on a trip to LA, I noticed my friend's skin was routinely glowing and come to find out??? She had been religiously using Barrier Bounce. I ordered it and now can't imagine my skincare routine without it. It isn't greasy, adds an additional layer of hydration to your skincare routine, and layers incredibly under foundation. 12/10. Suitable for all skin types and a Naturium staple.
Gives your skin the respite it needs. Peeling and red from retinol. Get this puppy and your skin will transform back to soft,supple and juicy!
I use this product twice a day. It has made a difference in my skin. The glow and moisture are fantastic!!!
Amazing product, I have super dry skin and I apply this over my facial oil and it locks the moisture in. It also provides a slight dewy finish for a beautiful glow

avis.titre: Holy Schnikes! This is what I've been looking for!
avis.texte: I have exceptionally dry skin and live in Alaska where we have extreme dry and cold In the winter. This is very rich and protective. I use DE C-Firma under this, then a good spf moisturizer over it for the day, and use this over the 0.5% retinol in the evenings and my skin looks nothing short of miraculous. Every fine line is plumped out, my skin glows, and stays hydrated even after a walk in below zero temps. Im a longtime skincare aficionado, and ive never used a lroduct like this. Its WONDERFUL!

avis.titre: I would definitely recommend this product
avis.texte: I have really sensitive skin, so typically different products can break me out or cause redness. This product helps make your skin very soft with its milky like consistency.
Dont be misled by the first intial few pumps. Shake really well. Seals in my actives and serums so well
